Communist Castro nationalizes banks and other industries, expelling American companies.
1,400 CIA trained ex-Cuban paramilitaries land (on Apr. 17/1961) in Cuba. These troops expect US naval and air support.
Fearing international backlash, JFK decides to hold back the promised support. The invasion fails after 3 days and the paramilitaries are taken prisoner.
